findings.body: The specified source for a statement leaf's raw predicate does not contain the required data. `StatementOutlineNode` in `backend/src/warehouse/statement-outline.interface.ts:1` contains a GL code and leaf key, but no plant or cost centre; the existing drill obtains the triples from the resolved mapping in `backend/src/mis/mis-drill.service.ts:107` and uses the outline only for node-to-leaf resolution. Thus an implementation cannot re-derive the promised exact predicate from the pinned outline and may fall back to current mapping or an over-broad GL predicate, risking non-footing results or raw-row exposure. Require the signed context to bind the executed resolved triples, or bind and verify the mapping version/resolved selection separately from the pinned outline.
findings.title: Bind statement-leaf triples instead of deriving them from the outline

findings.body: The spec supports any time window but repeatedly refers to one pinned budget batch/outline without selecting it. Current Ask provenance can contain a distinct budget batch for every result month (`backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:219`), and those outline snapshots can differ after partial reloads. The existing statement drill resolves this by selecting the budget batch at the block end (`backend/src/mis/mis-drill.service.ts:203`), but this spec does not adopt that rule or another reconciliation rule. Consequently multi-period GL fallbacks and statement labels can resolve from different outlines depending on implementation or query order. Specify the authoritative period/batch (for example, the time-window end) and bind that choice in the context.
findings.title: Define which outline governs a multi-period answer
